title: Pan-Seared Polish Pierogi with Minari and Polish Sausage
description: A hearty and flavorful dish featuring pan-seared pierogi filled with minari and served with polish sausage.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the pierogi according to package instructions (usually 3-5 minutes).
While the pierogi are cooking, melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the polish sausage to the skillet and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter to the skillet.
Add the minari to the skillet and cook until slightly caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add the cooked pierogi to the skillet and toss with the minari and sausage.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley and grated cheddar cheese if desired.
